available_measurements: Inventory records table/mat dimensions, scalar camera constraints and supplied bowl dimensions; none measures loaded jaw force, held-ball/tool displacement, or release response.

simulator_only_evidence.strict_hold_scoring: Both jaws positive force>0.01N, ball>30mm above initial support rest, ball/tool drift<=10mm at every10Hz sample
simulator_only_evidence.transport_rule: Original TrialTracker: held lift, transport, released in bowl and resting for 1s
simulator_only_evidence.scope: Four loaded states in provisional simulator geometry; three original-scene seeds plus one fixed image scene. Not four independent measured scenes. Contact solver formulation changes simulated dynamics.

required_physical_comparison: Match loaded and unloaded transport poses with requested/sent/measured gripper commands and timestamp provenance.
Measure ball-to-tool displacement over a declared hold duration with independent image registration and uncertainty; loaded joint tracking alone cannot establish retention.
Measure jaw gap or identified jaw angle under load and ball size/mass; measure force/current response if used to justify force parameters.
Measure release response at declared opening commands: release onset, whether sticking persists, ball separation and final settling; keep fitting and verification trials separate.

noslip.evidence: The tested option retains all four simulated 30-second holds and preserves four of four scripted releases, but no matching measured hold/release trace validates that behavior physically.

limitations: This is an audit of the listed existing records, not new hardware or video measurements. Recorded pick-and-place episodes and nominal CAD alone do not establish a physical 30-second retention or release-force curve.
